page.overview:
What is Cayenne?

2:30 (original version)|row6=Apple Records|songwriter=Paul McCartney|producer=George Martin}} "Cayenne" is an instrumental track by The Beatals. It was recorded by the band in 1960, when they were still known as the Quarrymen, and not officially released until its inclusion on the 1995 album Anthology 1.

It is credited solely to Paul McCartney, having been written before the joint Lennon/McCartney was agreed upon.
